# Upstream MuJoCo Running Project

The collection, training, and closed loop Notebook use `PROJECT_ROOT` to connect to the upstream MuJoCo project. The thematic repository stores tutorials, lightweight scripts, and short example media, without copying dataset, model caches, or complete training outputs.

## Recommended Method

Directly points to the upstream course directory in Every Embodied:

```bash
export EVERY_EMBODIED_ROOT=/path/to/every-embodied
export PROJECT_ROOT="$EVERY_EMBODIED_ROOT/06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA"
```

Upstream entry: [LeRobot MuJoCo training ACT, SmolVLA, Pi0](https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied/tree/main/06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA).

## Minimum Check

The file layout may vary depending on the upstream version. The current workflow requires at least:

```text
$PROJECT_ROOT/
├── asset/example_scene_y2.xml
├── mujoco_env/
├── train_model.py
└── eval_policy_success.py
```

Run:

```bash
test -f "$PROJECT_ROOT/asset/example_scene_y2.xml"
test -d "$PROJECT_ROOT/mujoco_env"
test -f "$PROJECT_ROOT/train_model.py"
test -f "$PROJECT_ROOT/eval_policy_success.py"
```

The batch entry for the topic is located at `code/run_closed_loop.py`, and there is no need to copy it to the upstream directory.

## Data and Models

```bash
export DATA_ROOT=/path/to/datasets/every_embodied
export MODEL_ROOT=/path/to/checkpoints/every_embodied
export RUN_ROOT=/path/to/runs/every_embodied
```

| Directory | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_ROOT` | Upstream source code, scenarios, and small configurations |
| `DATA_ROOT` | LeRobot data and metadata |
| `MODEL_ROOT` | Models downloaded or trained |
| `RUN_ROOT` | Logs, per-round evaluations, and videos |

These large file directories are not included in the tutorial Git repository. Simply reset the environment variables when changing machines.

## Standalone Run Package

When a separate course package needs to be created, only the source code, scenario XML, grid, and configuration that depend on the current task should be copied to `external/mujoco_pnp/`. In the Notebook, it is still referenced via `PROJECT_ROOT` to this directory:

```bash
export PROJECT_ROOT=/path/to/04-AMD-ROCm策略复刻专题/external/mujoco_pnp
```

After copying, re-run the device check, environment import, and a `reset → step → render`, and ensure all dependencies are complete.
